messages:
Emma: Ping — CloudFrame (acct CF-332) still hasn't paid INV-4822 (Feb). They disputed ~$12.3k labeled as 'high-cost embedding calls' and are asking for a 30-day installment instead of full payment.
Rajesh: Do we have meter/logs showing the spike? any refundable overages or misattributed model mapping?
Emma: Link to invoice + meter logs: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-4822 and https://logs.redwood.example/cf-332/usage/2026-02
Emma: Customer says a test connector doubled traffic and some requests hit the high-cost rerank model by mistake.
Jordan: CS checked — customer offered $5k payment now and wants to split remaining balance over 30 days. They asked explicitly for no service interruption while on plan.
Sara: My gut: propose structured installment (30% now, 35% at 15d, 35% at 30d) + require signed acknowledgement that remaining balance is non-disputed once plan accepted. We could waive late fee only if payments on time.
Henry: Legal: we need explicit language that they're withdrawing the dispute and releasing any chargeback rights for the agreed portion. I can draft standard MSA addendum.
Rajesh: Operational question: do we put a usage cap/alert while plan is active to avoid repeat spikes? Also need to confirm which model IDs were charged (so we can consider partial credit if wrong model was billed).
Emma: Noted — Jordan, can CS ask them to accept cap of X tokens/day and to sign the addendum? I can send draft.
Jordan: I can get them on a call tomorrow. They'll accept cap if we confirm no suspension.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 2nd_notice sent to CF-332 for INV-4822 at 1978642015. Next escalation: account hold in 7 days if unpaid.
Emma: I'd like to avoid hold. Plan: get initial $5k today, sign addendum, schedule 10am PT call to finalize. @Henry — can you have the addendum ready by EOD?
Henry: Yep, will draft and share in #legal-review by 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Sara: Also recommend we log this as a pricing anomaly and add to monthly pricing-experiments queue — if connector behavior is common we might need a metering rule.
Rajesh: I'll pull model IDs and the exact token counts and post a brief summary in this thread after taking a look at the logs.
Emma: Thanks — if we get $5k and signed doc, Collections will mark the invoice as On Payment Plan and remove imminent hold. Jordan please confirm after call.
Jordan: Will update after call. Thanks everyone.
